en.title: Captive PCR: PINS 14.4.3(1) exempts Class 1, 2 and 3 captives, while the AFSA Guidance (2020) says only Class 1 is exempt
en.summary: PINS 14.4.3(1) says Class 1, 2 and 3 Captive Insurers "are not required to calculate" the Prescribed Capital Requirement; 14.4.3(2) says each Cell of a Protected Cell Company "must calculate" it. Read with the heading, (2) is the specific rule for PCC cells. The AFSA's Guidance to the AIFC Captive Insurance Regime (13 December 2020) says only pure captives (Class 1) are exempt, which differs from 14.4.3(1).
en.correction: Please confirm whether the exemption in 14.4.3(1) is meant for Class 1 only (as in the Guidance) or for all classes, and align the text or the Guidance.

quotes.source: AIFC Insurance and Reinsurance Prudential Rules
quotes.text: A Captive Insurer is an Authorised Firm with a Licence to carry on Insurance Business as a Class 1, Class 2 or Class 3 Captive Insurer.

quotes.source: AIFC Insurance and Reinsurance Prudential Rules
quotes.text: An Authorised Firm which is a Protected Cell Company (PCC) incorporated under the Companies Regulations may apply to the AFSA for a Licence to conduct Captive Insurance Business.

quotes.source: AIFC Insurance and Reinsurance Prudential Rules
quotes.text: Class 1, Class 2 and Class 3 Captive Insurers are not required to calculate Prescribed Capital Requirement;

quotes.source: AIFC Insurance and Reinsurance Prudential Rules
quotes.text: For a Protected Cell Company each Cell of a Protected Cell Company must calculate its Prescribed Capital Requirement in accordance with PINS 5.2.3 (Obligation to calculate PCR) as if it were a stand-alone Insurer.

quotes.source: AIFC Insurance and Reinsurance Prudential Rules
quotes.text: An AIFC-Incorporated Insurer must at all times have Eligible Capital equal to or higher than the amount of its PCR.

quotes.source: Guidance to the AIFC Captive Insurance Regime for Captive Insurers and Captive Insurance Managers
quotes.locator: AFSA Guidance to the AIFC Captive Insurance Regime (13.12.2020), p.3
quotes.text: Because of the lower risk of pure captives (Class 1 in the AIFC), they are exempted from the obligation

quotes.source: AIFC Insurance and Reinsurance Prudential Rules (initial release)
quotes.locator: PINS initial release (2 December 2018), 14.4.3 - only the PCC sentence
quotes.text: Each Cell of a Protected Cell Company must calculate its Prescribed Capital Requirement in accordance with PINS 5.2.3 (Obligation to calculate PCR) as if it were a stand-alone Insurer.
